CDB's controlled benchmark uses reference lengths and recorded exits, but computes argmax tokens and feeds them back. Do not describe token values as replayed.
SNLP Table3 verified-drafter E2E speedups are theoretical. They are not our measured solver speedups.
WaveFront casts gate logits toFP32 before sigmoid. Code presence does not establish matching original-gate arithmetic.
FlashLoop BF16 removes quantization, not its sparsity approximations. Its efficiency baseline disables its own quantization/sparsity, not necessarily unoptimized HF.
